items.title: Operation DupeHike Attacking Employees Using Weaponized Documents DUPERUNNER Malware
items.description: A sophisticated attack campaign known as Operation DupeHike has emerged as a significant threat to Russian corporate environments, specifically targeting employees within human resources, payroll, and administrative departments. items.title: Critical React and Next.js Enables Remote Attackers to Execute Malicious Code
items.description: A critical security flaw in React and Next.js could let remote attackers run malicious code on servers without logging in. The issue affects React Server Components (RSC) and the “Flight” protocol used to send data between the browser and the server. items.title: Threat Actors Using Malicious VSCode Extension to Deploy Anivia Loader and OctoRAT
